verdict.rationale: Brave documents dedicated vertical endpoints for news, images, and video. Evidence includes a News Search API reference with a country parameter, image search with filtering and SafeSearch, and video search with metadata. It also offers local and place search endpoints, plus a Rich Search endpoint covering sports, stocks, and weather. The llms.txt probe and the official MCP server independently list web, image, video, and news search. missing for 10: no dedicated finance endpoint (stocks appear only as third-party-sourced rich-result enrichments), no independent or hands-on corroboration of vertical endpoint quality.
